## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Excess-word analysis of over 15 million PubMed abstracts (2010-2024) found an abrupt post-ChatGPT rise of style words (delve, underscore, crucial, pivotal, utilize, align), implying at least 13.5% of 2024 abstracts were LLM-processed, up to 40% in some subcorpora. ## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Word-list detection is contested: commentators attribute delve-style vocabulary to formal Nigerian business English of outsourced RLHF annotators, and vocabulary-based detectors risk false positives on formal or non-Western English. (low confidence) — https://simonwillison.net/2024/Apr/18/delve/ · keywords: Engineering-metaphor vocabulary tics in LLM output

## Facts and statements
